long_biography.plain_text:
Martinez's property interests pre-date his present group. In 2006 he jointly registered Homelife Properties for real-estate, housing-promotion and construction services, later serving as a manager of Home Life Mediterraneo and Contrimar Country. That sequence placed his career in Costa Blanca housing well before the businesses now associated with him.

The resulting platform separates operating development from investment-holding functions. JER Gestion de Participadas was formed to own and manage company stakes, while Area Promotora Aramar builds and sells homes. Area grew when a Contrimar unit holding development projects and property portfolios was transferred into the business, adding a substantial operating pipeline to a newly formed residential developer.

uncertainties.detail: The upstream record gives only Enrique Martinez, a common name, but connects it to Spirit of MK. The Balearic charter register ties that exact vessel to MK Services Nauticos; the official company filing names Jose Enrique Martinez Martinez as sole director and his JER holding company as sole shareholder. This resolves the abbreviated owner record at very high confidence. The public chain establishes management and corporate control, although it does not disclose JER's ultimate beneficial shareholders.

The Fnac Darty chief executive, WebCapitalists executive, artist Enrique Martinez Celaya and an Alicante-area Telefonica employee with the full Jose Enrique Martinez Martinez name are different people. No identity-secure personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok or personal website was found for the property developer. Only Area's official company website is proposed.

The self-made classification rests on positive founder evidence: Martinez was founding sole shareholder and sole director of ENRA Desarrollos, personally co-owned an earlier property-services trade mark and later became sole shareholder of another property company. No reliable source identifies inherited assets, succession to a family business, an inter vivos family transfer or a family-funded launch. The broader self-made value is used because his starting capital and degree of family advantage remain undocumented; self-made independent is not inferred from silence.

The public record directly establishes Martinez's past sole ownership of ENRA and Dreams of Alejandria and his management of JER, Area and the yacht company. It does not establish that he personally owns every current share in JER or Area, so the biography describes current directorships rather than asserting comprehensive beneficial ownership.

No authoritative public source reviewed gives Martinez's nationality, residence, gender, birth date or place of birth. Spanish corporate locations, the Spanish flag of the yacht and conventional name cues are not used as substitutes. Those fields remain blank.

Spanish filings write the legal name in surname-first capitals without diacritics, while WIPO presents Jose Enrique Martinez Martinez in conventional order. The proposals restore the compound given name and both surnames. The database-safe unaccented form is retained because the upstream record also omits diacritics and the primary official corporate filings do not supply them.

Property developer captures Martinez's defining practised role and Residential development captures the sustained operating field. Commercial real estate is omitted because the strongest evidence concerns housing development rather than office, retail or industrial property, while holding-company and yacht-charter activities do not warrant separate owner tags.
